module vending_machine (
    input clk, reset,
    input coin_inserted, item_selected,
    output [1:0] state
);

    reg [1:0] Q_reg;

    always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset) begin
            Q_reg <= 2'b00;
        end else begin
            case ({coin_inserted, item_selected})
                2'b00: Q_reg <= Q_reg; // No change
                2'b01: Q_reg <= 2'b00; // Reset to 00
                2'b10: Q_reg <= 2'b01; // Clockwise (right)
                2'b11: Q_reg <= (Q_reg == 2'b10) ? 2'b00 : 2'b10; // Counter-clockwise (left)
            endcase
        end
    end

    assign state = Q_reg;

endmodule

module rotate_left (
    input [7:0] in,
    input [2:0] shift,
    output [7:0] out
);

assign out = (shift == 3'b000) ? (in - 8'd1) :
              (shift == 3'b001) ? (in - 8'd2) :
              (shift == 3'b010) ? (in - 8'd3) :
              (shift == 3'b011) ? (in - 8'd4) :
              (shift == 3'b100) ? (in - 8'd5) :
              (shift == 3'b101) ? (in - 8'd6) :
              (shift == 3'b110) ? (in - 8'd7) :
              (shift == 3'b111) ? in : 8'h00;

endmodule

module decoder3to8(input [2:0] in, input enable, output [7:0] out);

    // For each bit in out, determine if enable and in satisfy the condition
    assign out[0] = enable & ~in[0];             // enable=1, in[0]=0
    assign out[1] = enable & (in[0] & ~in[1]);    // enable=1, in[0]=1, in[1]=0
    assign out[2] = enable & (~in[0] & ~in[1] & in[2]); // enable=1, in[0]=0, in[1]=0, in[2]=1
    assign out[3] = enable & (in[0] & in[1] & ~in[2]);  // enable=1, in[0]=1, in[1]=1, in[2]=0
    assign out[4] = enable & (~in[0] & in[1] & ~in[2]);   // enable=1, in[0]=0, in[1]=1, in[2]=0
    assign out[5] = enable & (in[0] & ~in[1] & ~in[2]);    // enable=1, in[0]=1, in[1]=0, in[2]=0
    assign out[6] = enable & (~in[0] & ~in[1] & ~in[2]);   // enable=1, all in bits=0
    assign out[7] = enable & (in[0] & in[1] & in[2]);     // enable=1, all in bits=1

endmodule

module decoder3to8(input [2:0] in, input enable, output [7:0] out);
    wire [7:0] D = 8'b1 << in;  // Generate 8-bit one-hot signal based on in
    assign out = enable ? 8'b0 : D; // Output D if enabled, else zero
endmodule

module TopModule (
  input [3:0] x,
  input [3:0] y,
  output [4:0] sum
);

  wire [3:0] p, g;
  wire [3:0] carry;

  assign p = x ^ y;         // Propagate signals
  assign g = x & y;         // Generate signals

  // Carry Look-Ahead Logic
  assign carry[0] = g[0];                // Initial carry-in is 0, carry[0] = g0
  assign carry[1] = g[1] | (p[1] & g[0]); // carry[1] = g1 | (p1 & g0)
  assign carry[2] = g[2] | (p[2] & g[1]) | (p[2] & p[1] & g[0]); // carry[2] logic
  assign carry[3] = g[3] | (p[3] & g[2]) | (p[3] & p[2] & g[1]) | (p[3] & p[2] & p[1] & g[0]); // carry[3] logic

  // Sum calculation using propagate and carry signals
  assign sum[0] = p[0];             // sum[0] = p0 (since carry[0] is 0)
  assign sum[1] = p[1] ^ carry[0];  // sum[1] = p1 ^ carry[0]
  assign sum[2] = p[2] ^ carry[1];  // sum[2] = p2 ^ carry[1]
  assign sum[3] = p[3] ^ carry[2];  // sum[3] = p3 ^ carry[2]
  assign sum[4] = carry[3];         // Carry-out is carry[3]

endmodule
